paper_title: Approximating the Fréchet Distance When Only One Curve Is c-Packed
statement: In this paper, we provide an O(c3 (n + m) log2d+1 (n) log m) time algorithm to (1 + ε)- approximate the Fréchet distance between two curves in Rd , in the case when only one curve is c-packed and ε is constant. The running time is nearly-linear if c and d are also constant. An open problem is whether the running time can be improved, in particular, whether the dependence on ε, c, d, log n or log m can be reduced. Another open problem is whether we can obtain results for related problems when only one of the two curves is c-packed. Yet another open problem is whether similar results can be obtained for other realistic input curves. In particular, can the Fréchet distance be (1 + ε)-approximated in subquadratic time when only one of the curves is κ-bounded, or when only one of the curves is ϕ-low density?
